summary: Iteration 139 (web-only): validated new Start Center Home + A/B toggle + /api/home/summary + Top Action Bar page sets + login landing. Backend 4/4 pass; frontend 11/12 scenarios pass. Only anomaly: /login?demo=1 with variant=new (localStorage tn:tn:home:variant='new') navigated to /dashboard URL but Start Center DOM did not render in the same session — final screenshot showed the login page. Requires main-agent verification (may be onboarding-tour overlay, or homeLanding not being called on the demo path when a prior sam session cookie is present).

integration_issues.issue: After localStorage tn:tn:home:variant='new' and navigating to /login?demo=1, URL correctly becomes /dashboard but StartCenterHome ([data-testid='home-start-center']) is not present; screenshot shows the login page still visible. Real-user impact is low because the primary path (sam login → click Try new Home → reload → /dashboard shows Start Center) works, and setting variant via UI toggle is the intended UX. Root cause hypothesis: the demoLogin() may have failed silently (a superadmin session cookie was already set) so homeLanding was called but nav landed on /dashboard without a fresh authed user, then AuthGuard rendered login. Not a regression — a corner case of the automation flow.

action_items: Verify demo-login path when tn:tn:home:variant='new' is pre-set and no user is authenticated — confirm Start Center renders on /dashboard (may need to inspect whether the demo cookie replaces an existing session cleanly).
Optional polish: add aria-describedby to NewTaskDialog's DialogContent — console emits a Radix a11y warning when opening the task dialog via /tasks?new=1.
critical_code_review_comments: homeVariant.js uses key 'tn:home:variant' but safeStorage double-namespaces to 'tn:tn:home:variant' (main-agent context notes this). Not a bug, but naming is confusing — recommend documenting or normalizing.

StartCenterHome.jsx: research chips are <span> with onClick and data-testid — non-semantic (should be <button>) and stopPropagation prevents the outer button navigation from firing when a chip is clicked (intentional). Consider role='button' + tabIndex for keyboard accessibility.
Dashboard.jsx uses localStorage directly for 'dash:invite-banner-dismissed' bypassing safeStorage — inconsistent with the rest of the codebase.
TopActionBar reads usage state only at mount via useState(readUsage) — the reordering is intentional, but a comment already documents it. OK.

rca of the issue: For the demo-login anomaly (Test 12): the automation flow set localStorage tn:tn:home:variant='new' while the sam@funasia.net session cookie was still set from earlier tests, then visited /login?demo=1. The demoLogin() call may have hit the backend with an existing session cookie and either failed (no clear console error visible) or the redirect landed on /dashboard before the new auth state propagated to the component tree, causing AuthGuard to briefly show the login page. This is a test-flow artifact more than a product bug. To reproduce cleanly: sign out fully (clear cookies), set variant to 'new' via the UI toggle on another account, sign out, click 'Try the demo' from /login.
